in_sanskrit.name: शिवशंकर
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: God Shiva, the lord of the mountains

in_hindi.name: शिवशंकर
in_hindi.long_meaning: शिव (Shiva) - पुरुषपरम्पराकार (god) + शंकर (शिवके परिवार में शक्तिपूज्य शंकर, lord of the mountains)

in_tamil.name: சிவசங்கர
in_tamil.long_meaning: சிவன் (Shiva) - மூழ்ச்சியர் (destroyer and regenerator) + சங்கரன் (lord of the mountains)

in_telugu.name: శివశేశ్ఖణ్దర్
in_telugu.long_meaning: శివయేశ్ (Shiva) - పరమేశ్వరయేశ్ (supreme lord) + శేశ్ఖణ్దర్ (lord of the mountains)

in_marathi.name: Shivashankar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Shiva + God of Mountain
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shivashankar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Shivashankar is a name derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Shiva’ and ‘Shankar’. Shiva is the name of the Hindu god of destruction, time, and creation. Shankar means the lord of the mountain or god of mountains. Therefore, Shivashankar can be interpreted as a powerful and strong name, invoking the blessings of the god Shiva.
